name: mobile-nav
title: Mobile Nav
description: A bottom tab bar for narrow screens: a named navigation of up to five links with the icon above the label, aria-current on the current page, an optional badge, and More, which opens the rest above the bar. Fixed to the bottom above the safe area, 56px targets, hidden above narrow: unless `always`. Glass gives it a translucent chrome fill.
docs: Pair it with a `Sidebar`: the sidebar on wide screens, this bar on narrow ones. `<Sidebar className="narrow:hidden" …/><PageLayout as="main" className="narrow:mb-(--mobile-nav-offset)">…</PageLayout><MobileNav label="Main" items={[{ label: "Home", href: "/", icon: <HomeIcon />, current: true }, …]} overflow={[…]} />`. The page keeps `--mobile-nav-offset` (the bar's `--mobile-nav-height`, 3.5rem, plus the bottom safe area) clear so nothing hides under it; add `viewport-fit=cover` to the viewport meta for the safe area to apply. Past five items, or with `overflow`, the fifth slot is More (`moreLabel`, English by default, and `moreIcon`). `renderLink` or `render` per item takes your router's link. It never uses viewport units.
